title: 潮水記得
subject: a tide coming back in
caption: Post-rock, largely instrumental. Two tremolo-picked electric guitars build over three minutes from a single clean arpeggio to a wall of delayed and overdriven sound, bass swelling underneath, drums entering with mallets and ending with full crashes. Wordless layered humming floats above the middle section; a single sung line arrives only in the last chorus. Cavernous reverb tails, very wide stereo image, no close vocal. 72 BPM, G major. Patient, building, finally bright.
